claim: You can use CloudFront to deliver video on demand (VOD) or live streaming video by using any HTTP origin; you must first use an encoder to package the video content, which creates segments and manifest files.

evidence.quote: You can use CloudFront to deliver video on demand (VOD) or live streaming video by using any HTTP origin.
You must use an encoder to package video content before CloudFront can distribute the content. The packaging process creates *segments* that contain your audio, video, and captions content.
It also generates manifest files, which describe in a specific order what segments to play and when.
